title: Composing and Decomposing Numbers up to 10
seo_title: Grade 1 Numbers up to 10 Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Compose and decompose numbers up to 10 using concrete materials (e.g., 5 is 5 and 0; 4 and 1; 3 and 2).
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets on composing and decomposing numbers to 10 for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: ten frames, pairs that make 10, part-part-whole and number bonds. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A number can be split into two parts: 5 is 5 and 0, 4 and 1, 3 and 2.
  • Put the parts together to make the whole again: 3 and 2 make 5.
  • A ten frame shows how many more make 10: 7 dots and 3 empty boxes.
  • Pairs that make 10: 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6, 5 and 5.

Examples

Example

8 is 5 and ☐

5 and 3 make 8

Answer: 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding the parts8 is 5 and 3, not 13.
Forgetting 06 is 6 and 0 too.
Counting empty boxesCount the dots, then the empty boxes.
